system.description:
LEVEL 3

Swiftshift. Whenever you roll Initiative, you may Beastshift for free. (1/turn) You can Beastshift between Direbeast Forms for 0 actions (this still costs a Direbeast Form charge).

Unleash the Beast. Gore also Taunts until the end of the target's next turn. Frenzy increases to 1d8+LVL damage.

LEVEL 7

Windborne Protector. Double the WIL armor and Temp HP bonuses from Fearsome Beast form. (1/encounter) You may Interpose from Reach 12.

Stormstrider. Double the DEX movement and Speed bonuses from Beast of the Pack. When you move as a Beast of the Pack, you may teleport instead.

LEVEL 11

Master of Forms. (1/encounter) When you would miss or crit while in a Direbeast form, you may increase or decrease the Primary Die by 1 instead.

LEVEL 15

Chimeric Sovereign. You know all Chimeric Boons, your Direbeast forms can have 2 at a time.
